_comment: Golden valid enrollment descriptor plus a rejection corpus. The valid object is the positive control; each rejection names the exact EnrollmentError variant the case must produce. Loaded by cli/src/enrollment.rs in-module tests. No secret material appears here: ca_ref is an opaque reference, never a credential. credential_ref is gone: credentials are PEM files at the identity path, not store references.

rejections.unknown_field: an extra top-level key such as "note" is UnknownField
rejections.bad_commit: commit not 40/64 lowercase hex is InvalidCommit
rejections.too_many_refs: more than 32 refs on a remote is TooManyRefs
rejections.non_full_ref: a ref not starting with refs/ is InvalidRef
rejections.empty_id: an empty or control-character org/project/repository id is InvalidField
rejections.credential_bearing_remote: a resolved remote URL carrying userinfo is CredentialBearingRemote
